from pocket_coffea.workflows.base_processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak

class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    def process_object_preselection(self, events):
        """Build a MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[
            (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        return events
    
    def process_object_counting(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
